source_note: Facts cross-checked against the app's question bank and standard references.

bullets.en: CPU = the brain of the computer. RAM = temporary memory (lost when power goes off); ROM = permanent.
bullets.ne: CPU = कम्प्युटरको मस्तिष्क। RAM = अस्थायी मेमोरी (बत्ती जाँदा हराउँछ); ROM = स्थायी।

bullets.en: Input devices: keyboard, mouse, scanner. Output devices: monitor, printer, speaker.
bullets.ne: इनपुट उपकरण: किबोर्ड, माउस, स्क्यानर। आउटपुट: मनिटर, प्रिन्टर, स्पिकर।

bullets.en: 1 byte = 8 bits; 1 KB = 1024 bytes. Computers work in binary (0 and 1).
bullets.ne: 1 byte = 8 bits; 1 KB = 1024 bytes। कम्प्युटर बाइनरी (0 र 1) मा काम गर्छ।

bullets.en: Hardware = physical parts; software = programs. The OS (Windows, Linux) is system software.
bullets.ne: हार्डवेयर = भौतिक भाग; सफ्टवेयर = प्रोग्राम। OS (Windows, Linux) सिस्टम सफ्टवेयर हो।

bullets.en: LAN = local-area network; WAN = wide-area network; the Internet = a global network of networks.
bullets.ne: LAN = स्थानीय सञ्जाल; WAN = फराकिलो सञ्जाल; इन्टरनेट = सञ्जालहरूको विश्वव्यापी सञ्जाल।

bullets.en: MS Word shortcuts: Ctrl+S save, Ctrl+C copy, Ctrl+V paste, Ctrl+Z undo, Ctrl+P print.
bullets.ne: MS Word सर्टकट: Ctrl+S सेभ, Ctrl+C कपी, Ctrl+V पेस्ट, Ctrl+Z अन्डु, Ctrl+P प्रिन्ट।

bullets.en: File extensions: .docx document, .xlsx spreadsheet, .pptx presentation, .pdf portable document.
A virus is a malicious program; antivirus software fights it; a backup is a spare copy of data.
bullets.ne: भाइरस हानिकारक प्रोग्राम हो; एन्टिभाइरसले लड्छ; ब्याकअप = डाटाको जगेडा प्रति।

bullets.en: Email: user@domain — with inbox, sent, draft and spam folders.
bullets.ne: इमेल: user@domain — inbox, sent, draft, spam फोल्डरहरू।

bullets.en: Alt+Tab switches windows; Ctrl+Alt+Del opens Task Manager (Windows).
bullets.ne: Alt+Tab ले विन्डो फेर्छ; Ctrl+Alt+Del ले Task Manager खोल्छ (Windows)।

bullets.en: 1 GB = 1024 MB. Storage: HDD (spinning disk) vs SSD (faster, no moving parts).
bullets.ne: 1 GB = 1024 MB। भण्डारण: HDD (घुम्ने डिस्क) vs SSD (छिटो, हल्लिने भाग छैन)।

bullets.en: URL = a web address; browsers: Chrome, Firefox, Edge.
bullets.ne: URL = वेब ठेगाना; ब्राउजर: Chrome, Firefox, Edge।
